text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Exploring, exploring, so much fun~! ♪
Hmmm? What's this wide open area?
text_block_list.orig_text:
探検、
探検♪　
楽しいなー！
あれ～、
なんだか広い所に出たよ？

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
I hardly noticed since we were so busy with our contests,
but it looks like we've climbed pretty high.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここまで勝負したり、
魔物と戦ったりして気付かなかったけど、
けっこう高くまで登ってきたよね。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Hmmm~? What's that lying on the ground?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ～？　
あそこになにか落ちてるよ？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh?!
What's all this?! This bright light...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃあっ！？　
なんですか！？　
この光は……！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: I-it's blinding me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まぶしいよぉっ！

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"What's up, Ayane?
Oh... you spotted the kid over there.Is he playing house with someone?\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『どうした、綾音？
ん～、
坊ちゃんが誰かと遊んでるな。
どうやらままごとしてるみたいだ』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Darling... ♪
Our little one is crying, so can you put her to sleep?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた～♪
赤ちゃんが泣いてるので、
あやしてあげてください。

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Darling? Is something wrong?
...Huh? Someone's peeking into the house?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた？　
どうしました？
……
えっ、
誰かがお家を覗いてる？

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"What's with the Peeping Tom treatment?!
Don't you dare say you've forgotten our faces!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『人を不審者扱いするんじゃねぇ！
てめぇ、
俺たちの顔を忘れたか？』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Oh... You're friends of {0}'s, right?
I'm, um... My name's Kurumi...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
お兄ちゃんの知り合いなんですね。
私、
あの、
くるみって言います……

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"Yo! Nice to meetcha, Kurumi!
I'm Pukichi, and this is Ayane!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『おう！　
よろしくな、
くるみ！
俺はぷうきち、
こっちは綾音だ』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: A-Ayane... and Pukichi. Nice to meet you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
綾音ちゃん、
ぷうきちくん、
よろしくね……

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"You wanting to play too, Ayane?
Hey, Kurumi. Mind if we join in the game?\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『綾音も一緒に遊びたいのか？
なぁ、
くるみ。
俺たちもままごとに混ぜてくれよ』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well, OK, sure!
Are you okay being me and {0}'s kids?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
うん、
いいよ。
くるみとお兄ちゃんの、
子どもの役でもいいかなぁ？

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"Sure, I ain't objecting. Let's get this show on the road.\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『おうっ、
かまわねぇよ。
じゃあさっそく始めるか』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Darling, Ayane, Pukichi!
Dinner is ready, everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お父さーん、
綾音ちゃーん、
ぷうきちくーん、
ごはんができましたよ～

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"Hamburg steak today, huh? Looks tasty, right, Ayane?\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『今日はハンバーグか。
やったな綾音！』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Here, d-darling, say \"ah\"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
あ、
あなた、
あ～ん……

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"Whoa there, you two. No getting all lovey-dovey in front of the kids!
You ain't newlyweds anymore!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『おいおいそこの二人、
ガキの前でいちゃいちゃしてんじゃねぇよ！
いつまで新婚気分なんだ？』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh?!
Darling, I think Ayane and Pukichi have reached a difficult age!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃあっ！？
あなた、
綾音ちゃんとぷうきちくんが反抗期だわ……！

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"Whassat?! All I did was say it like it is!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『なにぃっ！？　
ちょっと意見を言っただけだろうが！』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Our little Pukichi has started acting so aggressively...
Could this be because he saw us fighting the other day?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷうきちくんの言葉遣いがどんどん荒くなってる……
まさか、
この間の夫婦ゲンカを見てしまったせい！？

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"No, uh, I didn't mean anything like that...\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『いや、
別にそういうわけじゃ……』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Darling!
This is all because you cheated with that younger woman!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた！　
そもそも
あなたが若い女と浮気なんてするから……！

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"What kinda family are we dealing with here?!\"
text_block_list.orig_text: 『そんなドロドロな家族設定なのかよ！？』

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"Oh, look, it's almost three o'clock, so let's put the game on hold!
We oughtta take a nice snack break!\"
choice_data_list: Actually, I've got somewhere to be at three o'clock.
Oh shoot, I need to head off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『あぁ、
ほら、
もうすぐ３時だし、
ままごとは一旦中断だ！
おやつでも食べて休憩しようぜ！』

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"Say what?!
We were only just getting started here!
You tryin' to make Ayane cry?!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『なに～！？
まだ俺たちと遊び始めたばっかりだろ！？
綾音ががっかりするだろうが！』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Are you really leaving already?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……
お兄ちゃん、
もう行っちゃうの？

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"And he's gone... Dang, talk about a heartless jerk.\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『行っちまった……
薄情な奴だぜ、まったく……』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: It looked like he was in a rush to get somewhere...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃん、
あわててどこかへ行っちゃったね……

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"Fishy, if you ask me. Whaddaya say we follow him?\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『なんか怪しいよな……
後、つけてみねぇか？』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?! B-but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇっ！？　
でも……

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"C'mon, let's mosey! We don't wanna lose sight of him!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『ほら、早く早く！　
急がねぇと見失っちまうぞ！』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh... W-wait for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あうぅっ……
ま、
待ってぇ。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
C'mon, mister, you're late!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！
にいちゃん、
おっそーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: He's not late, Misogi. He's right on time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことないよ、
時間ぴったりだよ。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Hmm. As a grown-up, he should try to arrive five minutes early.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
大人なら５分前行動を
心掛けてほしいところですけど。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Well then, now that we're all here, let's start playing!
I thought it would be nice if we could play house today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
おにいちゃんも来てくれたし、
一緒に遊ぼうよ！
ミミ、
今日はみんなでおままごとしたいなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! I'm gonna be the mom, then!
Mimi, you're the kid, and Kyoka's our pet!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いーよ！　
じゃあ、みそぎがママの役！
ミミが子どもで、
鏡華がペットね！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Th-the pet?! Don't decide these things on your own!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぺ、
ペットって……
勝手に決めないでよ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Actually, I'd like to be the mommy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミも、
ママの役がいいな～

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Ehhh~? Didn't anyone teach you two not to be selfish?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーっ！？　
もう二人ともワガママだなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: You're the one who's being selfish here!
text_block_list.orig_text: ワガママなのはみそぎだよ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Well, if everyone wants to be the mommy,
why don't we play rock-paper-scissors for it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
誰がママ役をするかは、
ジャンケンで決めない？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, all right then. But I'm not gonna lose!
Ready, and... go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しょうがないなぁ。
それじゃあ勝負だ！　
ジャーンケーンポン！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I win! That makes me the mom!
You can be the big sister, Mimi, and Misogi, you're her little brother.
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝ったぁ！　
私がママ役だね！
ミミはお姉ちゃん役で、
みそぎは弟の役だよ。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Ehhh~?! How come I have to be a boy?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー！？　
なんで男の子役なの！？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Now now, Misogi. You mustn't make Mommy's life difficult.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みそぎちゃん、
ママを困らせちゃいけませんよぉ。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Mimi's already gone full big sis!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミ、
もうお姉ちゃんになりきってる！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
As for {0}... You can be the daddy.
I-I suppose that means you get to be my husband...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたは……
パパ役をお願いします。
し、
仕方ありませんから、
私の旦那さんにしてあげます……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
D-darling... Welcome home! ♪
Would you like a bath first? Or dinner?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あなた……
おかえりなさい♪
お風呂にしますか？　
それともごはん？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Daddy~! You're back early!
Did you have a good day at work? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
パパー！　
おかえりなさーい！
お仕事、おつかれさま♪

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Dad!
Did you harvest tons of bell peppers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
パパ、おかえりー！
今日はピーマンたくさん採れた？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Wait, what? A-are we a pepper-farming family?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちって、
ぴ、ピーマン農家さんだったの！？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Mommy!
What's for dinner? Something tasty?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ママ～♪
今日のごはんは、
なぁに？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
It's hamburg steak with omurice today.
And there's cupcakes for dessert!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はハンバーグとミニオムライス。
デザートはカップケーキですよ。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm~?
Hey, Mom, I don't see any veggies in here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ～？　
ママー、
これ、野菜が全然入ってないよ～？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: I-I sliced them up nice and small so you wouldn't complain!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
野菜は分からないように
細かく入れてるの！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh?
That's how your mom gets you to eat them, is it, Kyoka?
Sounds like hard work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ～ん。
鏡華のママは
いつもそうやって、鏡華に野菜を食べさせてるんだ～
たいへんだなぁ～

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please!
Try to stay in character, Misogi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もーっ！　
真面目にやってよ、
みそぎ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: I would, if this wasn't so boooring!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だぁって、
つまんないんだもーん！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
I really do wish I could play the mommy...
'Cause the mommy gets to be the daddy's wife, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミもやっぱり、
ママ役やりたいなぁ……
ママの役って、
おにいちゃんのお嫁さんってことだもんね。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: I wanna be married to {0} too!
text_block_list.orig_text: みそぎもにいちゃんのお嫁さんがいいー！

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
U... Um, Ayane...
That [i]is[/i] {0} with those girls, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
綾音ちゃん、
あれって、
お兄ちゃんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"I... I can't believe it! He's going behind both your backs,
and cheating with a buncha floozies?!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『し、
信じられねぇ！
綾音とくるみがいるくせに、
堂々と不倫するなんてよぉ！』

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"Hold it, buster! What's the meaning of all this, eh?!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『おいてめぇっ！　
これは一体どういうことだ！？』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Darling... You're at it again with your younger women?!
You adulterer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた……
やっぱり若い女がいいのね……！
この浮気者！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh?! What's going on now?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇっ！？　
なんですかいきなり！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
{0}, could it be...
When you proposed to me, you were already a married man?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか{0}さん、
既婚者でありながら
私と結婚したんですか！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Bigamy is a criminal offence, you know!
choice_data_list: W-we're still just playing house, right?!
This isn't the game I signed up for...
text_block_list.orig_text: 重婚は犯罪ですよ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Oh—yes, of course...
I got carried away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そうでしたね……
つい……

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"Say whaaaat?! Not a thought for the girls you left behind?!
This may be a game to you, but Kurumi and Ayane are serious!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『なんだと！？　
綾音とくるみに悲しい思いさせやがって！
てめぇにはままごとでも、
こっちは真剣なんだよ！』

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
I dunno who you two are, but Mr. {0}'s our daddy!
Aren't you, Mr. Daddy? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰だか知らないけど、
にいちゃんはみそぎたちのパパだぞ！
ねー、にいちゃんパパ♪

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: You are, right, Mr. Nice Daddy? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよね、
パパおにいちゃん♪

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Th-there must be some mistake...
This man is my lawful husband...
Right, Darling Big Bro?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなことないです……
お兄ちゃんは
私のだんなさまですよ……
ね、
お兄ちゃんあなた？

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"Daddies and misters and darlings and big bros...
This is enough to drive a bear crazy!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『パパとか、
にいちゃんとか、
あなたとか、
お兄ちゃんとか……
なんてカオスなままごとなんだ……』

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
S-settle down a moment, everyone!
Can't you see {0} is struggling to keep up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
み、
みんな落ち着いてください！
{0}さんが、
困っていますよ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: You're right. We should all play nice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね、
もっと楽しく遊ぼうよ。

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"Well then, to make things all fair and equal...
Let's say [i]I'm[/i] his blushing bride!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『それじゃあ、
みんな平等公平にってことで……
俺が坊ちゃんの奥さんになるぜ！』

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaa?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ええっ！？

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text: \"You girls are all our adorable daughters, got that?\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『みんなは、
俺と坊ちゃんの娘たちってことでいいな？』

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Good idea! ♪
Mr. Nice Guy can be everybody's Mr. Nice Daddy! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね～♪　
おにいちゃんは、
みんなのパパおにいちゃんだ～♪

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Kyoka, you're my little sister!
Go on, let's hear you call me \"Big Sis\"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
鏡華は、
みそぎの妹だ！
鏡華、
「みそぎお姉ちゃん」って呼んでみて！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Misogi! ♪
...Wait, was there any need for that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みそぎお姉ちゃん♪
……
って、
調子に乗らないの！

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: O-okay, everyone. All together now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それじゃあ、
せーの……

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Daddy~! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: パパー♪

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: *yawwwn*... Huh, when did I fall asleep...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふあ～あ……
いつの間に寝ちゃったんだろ……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Mnhh... Wha...? Weren't we playing house?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んん……
あれ？　
おままごとは？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Huh? You were dreaming about that too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
ミミもおままごとの夢見たの？

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Hey, me too!
I dreamt that we all married {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も見たよ！
お兄ちゃんとみんなが結婚する夢！

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?!
D-do you think we all had the same dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふえっ！？　
もしかして、
同じ夢を見てたのかな……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh...
It's kind of nice, all of us sharing the same dream!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
みんなとおんなじ夢を見てたなんて、
うれしいなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it really was a lot of fun...
But I'm feeling a bit worn out...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
すっごく楽しかったもんね。
でも、
ちょっと疲れちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
All right then, let's call it a day.
The match is a draw! {0} can be a big bro to all of us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
今日はもう帰ろう！
勝負は引き分け。
お兄ちゃんは
５人のお兄ちゃんだ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Agreed! All together now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さんせー！　
せーのっ……

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Big Bro! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: お兄ちゃん♪

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
I really had a good time today.
Hey, Mimi, Misogi, Kyoka...
W-would you like to play together again sometime?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はとっても楽しかったです。
ミミちゃん、
ミソギちゃん、
キョウカちゃん、
ま、
また
一緒に遊んでくれますか……？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Of course we would!
Happy Ayane, happy Kurumi, happy Misogi, happy Kyoka~♪
All happy, all smiley, all the best of friends~! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんだよ～！
アヤネちゃん♪　
クルミちゃん♪　
ミソギちゃん♪　
キョウカちゃん♪
みんな、
みんな、
おともだち～♪

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no backsies!
Oh, and you're coming too, mister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対遊ぼうね！　
あ、
当然、にいちゃんも一緒だからね！

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Of course he is!
After all, he's our precious big bro, isn't he?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ！　
お兄ちゃんは
私たち５人のお兄ちゃんだもんねー！

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: あはははは♪

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhh~? If it isn't my beloved big bro!
I wasn't expecting to run into you today, so this is a treat!
Good things come in small percentages, like they say! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ～！？　
お兄ちゃんじゃないですか～！
今日はもう会えないと思ってたから、
すっごくうれしいです♪
犬も歩けば棒アイスも当たる……
ですね☆

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaa?!
Big Bro, don't tell me... you've got even more...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇっ！？　
まさかお兄ちゃん、
私たちの他に妹が……

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, hey, big guy!
You'll help a sweet little sister out, won't you?
With my sax practice, I mean!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
お兄ちゃん！
これからアカリと
いいことしませんか？　
サックスの練習♪

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Geez, mister... How many little sisters do you need?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にいちゃん……
何人、妹がいるんだよぅ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Just when we thought you were our special big bro...
text_block_list.orig_text: ミミたちだけのおにいちゃんだと思ってたのに……

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
But to you, I suppose we were just
a few extra faces in your little sister collection...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちって、
お兄ちゃんの中では
大勢の妹のうちの一人にしか
過ぎないんですね……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: It's like I always said... You're a suspicious creep!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりこの人は……
へんたいふしんしゃさんです！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As Rino and Akari began to fawn over him,
{0} felt the cold stares of five little girls
upon his back...
text_block_list.orig_text:
リノとアカリに抱きつかれながら、５人の妹たちの冷たい視線を浴びる
{0}であった。
